meta.description: Queue for newly detected terms during Lexicon Out checks requiring operational definition and role validation.
meta.routing_rule: Every newly introduced term during a governed run MUST be added here with status GAP_OPEN.

notes: candidate_new_terms are not promoted to canonical_term automatically
noise_terms are retained but not promoted automatically

warp_lock.proposed_definition: Sustained anchored-scale opposition between a locked transport corridor and the local orientation basin.

harmonic_basin.proposed_definition: A stable, discrete phase-locked regime projected from a continuous oscillatory substrate.

anchored_scale.proposed_definition: Scale measured as harmonic deviation and persistence relative to the locally stabilized orientation operator.
